findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/run-summary.ts::forge observation uses headrefoid, not the spec's mergecommit
findings.title: Forge observation uses headRefOid, not the spec's mergeCommit
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec §3 names `--json state,mergeCommit`, but step 11.5 rules head-against-head (`headRefOid`): a squash always mints a new commit sha, so mergeCommit would raise a phantom-merge on every clean merge. The spec's own scenario ("merged at head bbb") matches headRefOid. Deviation recorded in the PR.

occurrences.title: Forge observation uses headRefOid, not the spec's mergeCommit

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/run-summary.ts::the measure env keeps home/userprofile/claude_config_dir
findings.title: The measure env keeps HOME/USERPROFILE/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec 4.1 says the env is built only from the ledger. Transcripts are located under $HOME/.claude, so an env without HOME meters nothing. Only the locating variables are kept; the session id still comes from the ledger, and the determinism test varies the ambient session id.

occurrences.title: The measure env keeps HOME/USERPROFILE/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/budget.js::buffered stderr is lost if composition throws
findings.title: Buffered stderr is lost if composition throws
findings.refutation: budget.js: the pushes follow computeBudgetState; mutateLedgerUnderLock is wrapped in `try { … } catch { /* best-effort */ }`.
findings.disposition_rationale: The three pushes sit after the window block, whose only write is inside try/catch; nothing after them can throw. economicsCore buffers no stderr.

findings.disposition_rationale: Each stderr line is the same message pushed into state.warnings, so the returned state carries all of them; the wrapper's comment now says so.

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/budget.js::buffered stderr is still lost if budgetcheckcompose throws
findings.title: Buffered stderr is still lost if budgetCheckCompose throws
findings.refutation: budget.js: readGovernanceConfig and envelope resolution run before any stderr.push; mutateLedgerUnderLock is wrapped in try/catch.
findings.disposition_rationale: The stderr pushes all follow the window block; the throw points (readGovernanceConfig, the ledger read) precede every push, and the only ledger write is inside try/catch. No line is buffered when a throw can still happen.

occurrences.title: Buffered stderr is still lost if budgetCheckCompose throws

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/budget.js::the persistwindow default flip changes window semantics for callers
findings.title: The persistWindow default flip changes window semantics for callers
findings.refutation: budget.js: `if (persistWindow) try { mutateLedgerUnderLock(...) } catch {}` is followed unconditionally by `windowTokens = 0; windowResetEpoch = resetEpoch;`.
findings.disposition_rationale: windowTokens and windowResetEpoch are set whether or not the anchor persists, so the returned state is identical; budgetCheckForRun is new in this branch and run summary is its only caller.

occurrences.title: The persistWindow default flip changes window semantics for callers
